OpTic Gaming is an American esports organization primarily known for its Call of Duty team. On June 12, 2019, the organization was acquired by Immortals Gaming Club. [1] It was later reacquired by OpTic Gaming's founder Hector "H3CZ" Rodriguez on November 11, 2020. [2]

  • January 4th - OpTic Gaming sign the former roster of Conquest, which consists of ShahZaM, daps, RUSH, NAF, and stanislaw. [3]
  • April 13th - OpTic Gaming part ways with ShahZaM and acquire mixwell from gBots eSports Club as a replacement. [4]
  • June 21st - OpTic Gaming sign Devilwalk as their new coach. [5]
  • August 20th - OpTic Gaming release stanislaw and acquire tarik from Counter Logic Gaming as a replacement. [6]
  • August 25th - OpTic Gaming part ways with Devilwalk. [7]
  • September 14th - OpTic Gaming bench daps and sign stanislaw. [8]
  • September 27th - daps announces that he has left the team. [9]
  • February 1st - OpTic Gaming part ways with stanislaw. [10]
  • March 28th - jasonR joins the team as a long term stand-in and opts into the in-game leading role. [11]
  • June 14th - jasonR leaves OpTic Gaming. [12]
  • July 7th - OpTic Gaming sign ImAPet as coach. [13]
  • August 15th - RUSH and tarik are acquired by Cloud9. [14]
  • August 21st - OpTic Gaming sign a brand new European roster. friberg, allu and Magisk join. [15]
  • August 29th - HS is acquired from PENTA Sports to complete the roster. [16]
  • September 1st - NAF transfers to Renegades. [17]
  • February 6th - OpTic Gaming part ways with mixwell. [18]
  • February 7th - Magisk is acquired by Astralis. [19]
  • February 7th - OpTic Gaming announce their new roster, consisting of stanislaw, ShahZaM, k0nfig, and cajunb. Additionally, gade joins on a 6 month loan from North Academy. [20][21]
  • February 11th - OpTic Gaming part ways with friberg. [22]
  • February 16th - OpTic Gaming part ways with HS. [23]
  • March 12th - allu is acquired by ENCE eSports. [24]
  • April 24th - Snappi and JUGi replace stanislaw and ShahZaM. ruggah replaces ImAPet as coach. [25]
  • September 27th - gade leaves OpTic Gaming to join North. [26]
  • September 28th - OpTic Gaming sign niko. [27]
  • December 31st - OpTic Gaming bench niko and sign refrezh. [28]
  • January 31st - niko is acquired by Rogue. [29]
  • March 28th - cajunb steps down from the active roster. OpTic Gaming sign MSL and niko. [30][31]
  • April 1st - cajunb's contract expires and he becomes a free agent. [32]
  • May 2nd - JUGi is acquired by North. [33]
  • June 12th - OpTic Gaming are acquired by Immortals Gaming Club. [1]
  • June 18th - OpTic Gaming part ways with Snappi. [34]
  • August 10th - OpTic Gaming replace refrezh with cajunb. [35]
  • October 11th - Due to a lack of organization support arising from OpTic Gaming's acquisition by Immortals Gaming Club and cajunb's acquisition by North, the remainder of the players bench themselves as they await acquisition or the expiration of their contracts. [36][37]
  • November 6th - k0nfig is acquired by Complexity Gaming. [38]
  • December 1st - ruggah's contract expires and he leaves OpTic Gaming. [39]
  • January 17th - MSL is acquired by North. [40]
  • February 24th - refrezh is acquired by Copenhagen Flames. [41]
  • April 20th - niko is acquired by Heroic. [42]
